vv78:1.1: Sovaṇṇamaye pabbatasmiṃ sabbato pabhaṃ hemajālakapacchannaṃ kiṅkiṇijālakappitaṃ. || ||
vv78:2.1: Aṭṭhaṃsā sukatā thambhā sabbe veḷuriyāmayā eka-m-ekāya aṃsiyā ratanā satta nimmitā. || ||
vv78:3.1: Veḷuriyasuvaṇṇassa phaḷikārūpiyassa ca masāragallamuttāhi lohitaṅkamaṇīhi ca || ||
vv78:4.1: Citrā manoramā bhūmi na tatth' uddhaṃsatī rajo gopāṇasīgaṇā pītā kūṭaṃ dhārenti nimmitā. || ||
vv78:5.1: Sopānāni ca cattāri nimmitā caturo disā nānāratanagabbhehi ādicco va virocati. || ||
vv78:6.1: Vediyā catasso tattha vibhattā bhāgaso mitā daddallamānā ābhanti samantā caturo disā. || ||
vv78:7.1: Tasmiṃ vimāne pavare devaputto mahappabho atirocasi vaṇṇena udayanto va bhānumā. || ||
vv78:8.1: Dānassa te idaṃ phalaṃ atho sīlassa vā pana atho añjalikammassa taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito
vv78:9.1: ti. || || So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv78:10.1: Ahaṃ Andhakavindasmiṃ buddhass' ādiccabandhuno vihāraṃ satthu kāresiṃ pasanno sehi pāṇihi. || ||
vv78:11.1: Tattha gandhañ ca mālañ ca paccayañ ca vilepanaṃ vihāraṃ satthuno 'dāsiṃ vippasannena cetasā. || || Tena mayhaṃ idaṃ laddhaṃ vasaṃ vattemi Nandane
vv78:12.1: Nandane ca vane ramme nānādijagaṇāyute ramāmi naccagītehi accharāhi purakkhato ti. || ||
